Propose now.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_w1zbVLBTSKHKMEbvt9MW4254","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run, step } from \"zttp:durable\";\n\nstructural OrderProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\n// One durable run keyed by Idempotency-Key. `reserve` then `charge` are\n// recorded as separate steps at step depth 0, so a retry replays the\n// journal instead of re-reserving or double-charging the order.\nexport function handler(req: Request): OrderProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const reservation = step(\"reserve\", () => ({ reservationId: \"rsv-1\" }));\n    const charge = step(\"charge\", () => ({ chargeId: \"chg-1\" }));\n    return Response.json({\n      reserved: reservation !== undefined,\n      charged: charge !== undefined\n    }, { status: 201 });\n  });\n}\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29120,"completion_tokens":613,"total_tokens":29733,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":28928},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":213},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":28928,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":192},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
